properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-2 from hash.js, sitting on web3's signing path: elliptic uses it to seed HMAC-DRBG during ECDSA key generation and signing. Ships SHA-1 (legacy) alongside SHA-2; nothing in the app's own code calls SHA-1 directly — the library's availability in the shipped bundle is what is inventoried.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA over secp256k1 — the curve mandated by the Ethereum/Polygon protocol for every transaction signature, including this dApp's mint transaction (src/App.js:132-139), which web3.js 1.8.2 builds and MetaMask signs in the user's browser. Quantum-unsafe under Shor, but observable here and replaceable only by the chain protocol (post-quantum account abstraction), not by this app. Migration target at protocol level: ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey (npm) implements OpenSSL's legacy EVP_BytesToKey — a single-round, MD5-based KDF deriving key+IV. All 8 sites are lockfile declarations; the package ships transitively via browserify-aes ^1.0.3 / browserify-cipher ^1.0.0 → crypto-browserify 3.12.0, react-scripts' browser polyfill for node's crypto module. Available in the shipped library; no first-party call site — the app's only crypto flow goes through MetaMask. CBOM note: MD5 also ships as a standalone hash backend — md5.js@1.3

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is the bcrypt-pbkdf npm package v1.0.2 (OpenSSH's bcrypt_pbkdf KDF), not the bcrypt password-hashing package: it ships via sshpk@1.17.0 (SSH key parsing in the http-signature chain, itself pulled by webpack-dev-server/request). It derives keys from passphrases with bcrypt's core; tweetnacl provides its SHA-512. Available in the shipped library; no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@0.10.0 ships full RSA (keygen, PKCS#1 encryption, signing). Pulled in via selfsigned@1.10.14 → webpack-dev-server (self-signed dev HTTPS certificate). Available in the shipped library; no call site in the application code — the dapp's only crypto path is MetaMask. Changeable here only by upgrading react-scripts/webpack-dev-server. CBOM note: a second, production-side RSA capability ships via public-encrypt@4.0.3 in the crypto-browserify chain (package-lock.json:5347 declaration, :1655

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: create-ecdh@4.0.0 is the browserify ECDH implementation (crypto.createECDH polyfill, backed by elliptic for curves like secp256k1/P-256), a dependency of crypto-browserify 3.12.0 (react-scripts' node-crypto polyfill), so classical ECDH ships in the build whether or not the app calls it. No first-party call site: the app never creates an ECDH object; all signing/keys are delegated to MetaMask. CBOM note: the same crypto-browserify chain also ships finite-field Diffie-Hellman — diffie-hellman@5.0.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 provides Ed25519 signing (nacl.sign.detached). Shipped via sshpk (~0.14.0) and bcrypt-pbkdf (^0.14.3), both present in the lockfile. Available in the shipped library; no application call site. Shor-vulnerable signature scheme — migration class ML-DSA-65 when planned.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Pure-JS ECDSA/ECDH over secp256k1: eth-lib@0.2.8 uses it in web3-eth-accounts for account signing, and browserify's create-ecdh uses it in the browser bundle. Same protocol-bound migration as the secp256k1 package object — the app can only observe; the Ethereum protocol decides when signatures change.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5's nacl.box implements X25519 (curve25519) key agreement combined with XSalsa20-Poly1305. Shipped via sshpk/bcrypt-pbkdf. Available in the shipped library; no application call site. Harvest-now-decrypt-later class if ever used for key agreement.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256, Ethereum's hash — note it is the legacy Keccak padding, not the FIPS-202 SHA3-256 variant, so the 'SHA-3' label is approximate. Used for transaction hashing, address derivation and ABI function-selector computation on every contract call this dApp makes. Grover-only exposure; hashes are not an urgent PQ migration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 capability inside web3's account module: used for BIP39 mnemonic→seed / BIP32 derivation and the PBKDF2 keystore KDF when accounts are handled in JS. The lockfile declares the primitive only; iteration count, salt and PRF are chosen by callers at runtime (web3-eth-accounts / ethereum-cryptography code) and are not visible in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 is a direct dependency of web3-eth-accounts@1.8.2 (package-lock.json:20947) — the V3 keystore encrypt/decrypt path, where scrypt derives the symmetric key from the passphrase — and of ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 (package-lock.json:7030). This is the strongest KDF object in the tree: it sits on web3's live account-handling path, the one dependency chain the dapp actually exercises. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@0.10.0 ships AES (CBC/CTR/GCM among its modes). Available in the shipped library via selfsigned → webpack-dev-server; no application call site. CBOM note: the production-side crypto-browserify chain also ships legacy block ciphers that no inventory object enumerates — browserify-des@1.0.2 (DES-CBC and 3DES-EDE-CBC; declared at package-lock.json:4250 inside browserify-cipher@1.0.1, entry at :4254) built on des.js@1.0.1 (entry at :5976). properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5's nacl.secretbox/nacl.box use XSalsa20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption. Shipped via sshpk/bcrypt-pbkdf. Available in the shipped library; no application call site. Symmetric AE — quantum impact limited to Grover's square-root speedup, not Shor.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 is a declared lockfile dependency — required by sshpk@1.17.0 (~0.14.0, package-lock.json:18583) and bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 (^0.14.3, package-lock.json:4055) — so the library and its algorithms (Ed25519, X25519, XSalsa20-Poly1305) ship in node_modules. The '.' site is a collector summary artifact pointing at the root, not an application call site; no import of tweetnacl exists in src/.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@0.10.0 is a declared lockfile dependency — required by selfsigned@1.10.14 (^0.10.0, package-lock.json:17925) → webpack-dev-server. The full forge suite (RSA, X.509, AES, ...) ships in node_modules for the dev toolchain. The '.' site is a collector summary artifact pointing at the root; no import of node-forge in first-party code. Changeable here by upgrading react-scripts/webpack-dev-server.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: selfsigned@1.10.14 generates self-signed X.509 certificates (node-forge under the hood) for webpack-dev-server's optional HTTPS dev mode. Dev-toolchain asset: it is not part of the production dapp bundle's runtime crypto, and production TLS termination is the hosting platform's concern, not this repo's. Changeable here by upgrading react-scripts/webpack-dev-server.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@0.10.0's X.509 support (cert creation/parsing) is what selfsigned@1.10.14 uses to mint the dev server's self-signed certificate. Same chain as LIB-fe0eb9a4: dev toolchain, observable here, replaceable by upgrading react-scripts/webpack-dev-server.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt KDF for Ethereum V3 keystore (encrypted JSON wallet) files: web3-eth-accounts@1.8.2 requires it at lockfile line 20947 for wallet encrypt/decrypt, ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 at 7030/27429 for BIP32/BIP39 support. scrypt's N/r/p parameters are chosen by web3 at runtime, not declared in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-224/256/384/512 implementations that ship in web3's browser bundle; SHA-1 rides along as legacy availability. No direct call site in the app's own code — presence in the shipped dependency tree is the inventory fact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4, web3 1.8.x's pure-JS ECDSA implementation (via eth-lib and create-ecdh). Kept once under the ECDSA entry; reference it instead of chasing this object's sites.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Generates the webpack dev server's self-signed X.509 certificate (RSA keypair via node-forge, tracked as its own object) when HTTPS dev serving is enabled. Dev-only tooling — never in the production bundle — but part of the dependency tree this lockfile pins. Changeable here by bumping react-scripts/webpack-dev-server.

properties.name: pqs:context
